parameters.content:
## B · Quote Intake — the anti-ghosting pipeline
POST /webhook/pure-polymers/quote (schema pp.quote.v1)

**Order matters:** validate → de-duplicate on submissionId → persist (data table, then master sheet) → RESPOND to the browser → only then notify.
The buyer never waits on Gmail, and a Sheets outage cannot lose a lead: the ledger row is already written and ops gets an alert.

Setup: create the `pp_quote_ledger` data table, pick the master spreadsheet on both Sheets nodes, and set CONFIG.mode to `live` inside "Validate & Normalize" once the routing addresses are confirmed.

## Dual notification
Internal: routed by product family to the desk that prices it, with a lead score, the SLA due time and one-tap reply buttons. Hot leads can also ping WhatsApp (node disabled until a template is approved).

External: the buyer gets the reference, a dated promise, the spec we received, the TDS from the Drive library and the 5% Colors Visualizer offer — the reason they stop shopping around.
